answer: Locks are logged in summit, expire in voyage, and delta lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 19 aliases as a result needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1855 identities would post 769 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
